title: Mark a claim verified only when the source supports it
narrative: Fangore is checking whether a cited source supports an atomic claim before his product marks it verified. He runs the decision-plane citation path with a matching source and claim, reads the bounded support answer, and verifies product policy sets the claim verified — the model alone never stamps verification. Related policy stories: `fangore_decision_plane_policy`, `fangore_refund_verdict`.[^jev-us04][^jev-insp-cite]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` runtime (`run_decision_plane_policy`) answers a bounded support choice (`supported` / `contradicted` / `insufficient` / `unavailable`). Host policy sets `claim_verified` only when the final action is `supported` and the path does not escalate.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/matching_claim.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
